config_channel_summary.statement: Of the nine branches, only formula_font can be narrowed from configuration, and only by replacing the whole broad pattern. character_class_start and character_class_middle have a configuration item but it can only widen. The remaining six have no configuration channel at all. The upstream configurable surface therefore does not cover this failure mode except at one branch, and there only bluntly.
